description: Build the webapp backend layer: a FastAPI application living entirely in the NEW folder webapp/ that imports normakit as a read-only library and exposes (a) live robot telemetry + camera over WebSocket, (b) a chat endpoint driving the existing Claude tool-use loop (reuse SYSTEM/TOOLS/run_tool from src/normakit/agent.py verbatim by import - that file must not be edited), (c) hard safety gating: sim backend by default, station backend refused without --i-have-a-human, per-session human-presence confirmation (10-min window) before any motion tool is forwarded in station mode, and an e-stop API calling arm.guard.estop(). All motion flows through Arm/Guard only - never call Backend.send_goals directly. Ships with pytest tests that need no hardware and no API key (anthropic client mocked). Frontend static/ comes in FEAT-003; this feature leaves a bootable API server.
steps: Create webapp/ layout: webapp/run.py (CLI entry), webapp/app.py (create_app factory + routes + WebSocket), webapp/agent_bridge.py (Claude tool-use loop with event callbacks), webapp/safety.py (motion-tool classification + HumanGate), webapp/tests/{conftest.py,test_api.py,test_agent_bridge.py,test_safety.py}, webapp/requirements.txt (documentation only: fastapi, uvicorn[standard], anthropic, pytest - all already in .venv; do NOT pip install).

sys.path pattern: mirror server/policy_server.py - every webapp module does sys.path.insert(0, <repo>/src) computed from __file__ so `import normakit` works when run as .venv/bin/python webapp/run.py from the repo root.

webapp/run.py: argparse mirroring scripts/run_policy.py: --backend sim|station (default sim), --host 127.0.0.1, --port 8920 (8920 chosen: 8888/8889/8890/8891/8000 are taken), --station-host localhost:8888, --i-have-a-human (store_true). If backend == station and not i_have_a_human: print 'refusing: station backend needs --i-have-a-human (a person must be at the table)' to stderr and exit 2 - exactly mirroring run_policy.py lines 76-82. Build the arm via normakit.mcp_server.build(backend, station_host) inside a try/except that prints a clear error and exits non-zero (StationBackend raises RuntimeError when Station is unreachable). Then uvicorn.run(create_app(...), host, port).

webapp/safety.py: MOTION_TOOLS = {'pick_cell','place_cell','reach_cell','reach_xyz','gripper','home','move_joints','calibrate_table'}; NON_MOTION = {'look','arm_state','stop','release'}. class HumanGate(backend): confirm(minutes=10) sets confirmed_until; ok() True for sim always, for station True only while now < confirmed_until; remaining_s(). Also a threading.Lock-annotated single-writer rule: the agent loop and any direct motion call must hold the same lock (one writer on the bus, AGENTS.md rule 6).

webapp/agent_bridge.py: function run_chat(arm, text, on_event, gate, client=None, model=None, max_turns=25, cancel=None) -> dict. Import SYSTEM, TOOLS, run_tool, MODEL from normakit.agent (read-only import). Build anthropic.Anthropic() only if client is None; if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing, on_event({'type':'error','text':'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set - export it and retry'}) and return without calling the API. Loop mirrors agent.run: append assistant content, for each tool_use emit on_event({'type':'tool_use','name','input'}), execute via normakit.agent.run_tool BUT first: if tool in MOTION_TOOLS and not gate.ok(): skip execution and feed the model a tool_result error 'motion blocked: human-presence confirmation required (station mode)' - this is the gate enforcement point; cancel (threading.Event) checked each turn -> emit {'type':'cancelled'} and stop. For look results (list of image content blocks) emit {'type':'image','jpeg_b64': ...} (send as-is, 640x480 ~50KB is fine on localhost); text results emit {'type':'tool_result','name','result'}. Final text emits {'type':'final','text'}. Return {llm_calls, tool_calls, seconds, final} like agent.run does. Do NOT write run/trials.jsonl from the webapp (that file is the other loop's; keep the web layer read-only on repo files).

webapp/app.py: create_app(arm, backend, gate=None, model=None) -> FastAPI. Routes: GET / -> serve webapp/static/index.html if present else a tiny placeholder page (FEAT-003 adds the real one); GET /api/status -> {backend, model, estopped, human_confirmed: gate.ok(), human_window_s: gate.remaining_s(), anthropic_key: bool(os.environ.get('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY')), cameras: arm.backend.cameras()}; POST /api/estop -> arm.guard.estop() (in a thread, it calls halt) -> {ok, estopped: true}; POST /api/release -> arm.guard.release(); POST /api/confirm-human -> gate.confirm() -> {ok, window_s} (no-op success in sim); WebSocket /ws: server pushes telemetry every 0.5 s {type:'state', joints: arm.state().to_json(), estopped, agent_active, backend} and camera frames {type:'frame', camera:'table'|cam0, jpeg_b64} ~every 0.7 s (alternate; use station_backend.front_camera(arm.backend) when backend=='station' to pick the table camera, wrapped in try/except so a missing camera never kills the socket). All arm calls are blocking - run them with asyncio.to_thread / anyio.to_thread. Client -> server messages on the same socket: {'type':'chat','text'} -> run agent_bridge.run_chat in a thread (only one agent at a time: reject with {'type':'error'} while agent_active; set agent_active True/False around it) forwarding on_event payloads into the socket; {'type':'estop'} same as POST /api/estop; {'type':'cancel'} sets the cancel Event of the running chat. Wrap every socket send in try/except and never let a telemetry error (e.g. camera timeout) close the loop - send {'type':'telemetry_error','text'} and continue.

E-stop semantics: estop must also set the cancel event of any running chat so the agent stops issuing tools at the next turn boundary (Guard already refuses motion while estopped - that is the hard layer; cancelling is the convenience layer).

webapp/tests/conftest.py: sys.path.insert src + webapp; session-scoped fixture sim_arm -> normakit.mcp_server.build('sim','') ; fixture app -> create_app(sim_arm,'sim'); fixture client -> fastapi.testclient.TestClient(app); fixture station_gated_app -> create_app(sim_arm, 'station', HumanGate('station')) (sim backend under a station-mode gate so no hardware is needed to test the gate).

webapp/tests/test_api.py: (1) GET / returns 200. (2) GET /api/status returns 200 JSON with backend=='sim' and 'anthropic_key' field. (3) POST /api/estop -> estopped True; then arm.guard.move({1:0.5}) returns ok False (Guard latch); POST /api/release restores (call release in teardown so other tests are unaffected). (4) WebSocket /ws: with client.websocket_connect('/ws') read messages until a {'type':'state'} with joints for all 8 joints and a {'type':'frame'} with non-empty jpeg_b64 arrive (timeout-guarded loop, ~40 reads max).

webapp/tests/test_agent_bridge.py: mock the anthropic client - build a FakeMessages whose create() returns canned blocks: turn 1 tool_use look(grid=true), turn 2 tool_use home, turn 3 text 'done' (construct simple namespace objects with .type/.name/.input/.id/.text matching anthropic's shapes; run_chat only needs those attributes + resp.content list). Pass client=FakeClient into run_chat with a real sim arm and gate=HumanGate('sim'). Assert: events include tool_use look, an image event with decodable base64 jpeg (PIL.Image.open on BytesIO works), a final event 'done', and the returned dict has tool_calls == 2. Second test: missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (monkeypatch.delenv + client=None) -> an error event mentioning ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and zero API calls.

webapp/tests/test_safety.py: (1) HumanGate('station') blocks: run_chat with gate=HumanGate('station') (unconfirmed) and a FakeClient whose first turn is tool_use home -> the model receives a tool_result containing 'human-presence confirmation required', no motion happened (sim arm state norms all still ~0.5), and after gate.confirm() a second run_chat with home succeeds (event tool_result for home present). (2) run.py refuses station without the flag: run `.venv/bin/python webapp/run.py --backend station --port 8999` via subprocess with timeout, assert exit code 2 and stderr mentions --i-have-a-human. (3) estop during chat: start run_chat with a FakeClient scripted for several home calls, set arm.guard.estop() after the first tool_use event, assert subsequent tool_results contain 'e-stop active' (Guard's own error string from core.py) - proving the web layer cannot bypass Guard.
Keep runtime artifacts out of git: webapp writes nothing to the repo at runtime (no logs/, no run/). Tests must not write outside webapp/ either.

Update this feature file's findings with the test results. Do NOT commit - the commit happens in FEAT-003 once docs exist (or commit now only paths webapp/ if you prefer a split commit; never git add -A).

findings: Implemented the full webapp backend layer as new files only: webapp/run.py (CLI entry, mirrors run_policy.py refusal), webapp/app.py (create_app factory: GET / placeholder until FEAT-003, GET /api/status, POST /api/estop|release|confirm-human, WS /ws with 0.5 s state + 0.7 s frame push loops and chat/estop/cancel client messages), webapp/agent_bridge.py (run_chat reusing normakit.agent SYSTEM/TOOLS/run_tool/MODEL by read-only import; HumanGate blocks motion tools with a tool_result error; cancel Event checked per turn; no run/trials.jsonl writes), webapp/safety.py (MOTION_TOOLS/NON_MOTION + HumanGate with 10-min window and the single-writer threading.Lock), webapp/tests/{conftest,test_api,test_agent_bridge,test_safety}.py, webapp/requirements.txt (documentation only, nothing installed). VERIFICATION (all run, all green): (1) env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY .venv/bin/python -m pytest webapp/tests -q -> 10 passed in 1.19s (5 test_api incl. WS state+frame and estop latch, 2 test_agent_bridge with FakeClient incl. missing-key path, 3 test_safety incl. station-gate block/confirm, subprocess refusal exit 2, estop-during-chat surfacing Guard's 'e-stop active'); (2) .venv/bin/python scripts/selftest_sim.py -> ALL OK exit 0 (untouched baseline, pre-existing benign pybullet/twin-timeout INFO lines unchanged); (3) boot: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY .venv/bin/python webapp/run.py --backend sim --port 8920 -> GET /api/status 200 {"backend":"sim","model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","estopped":false,"human_confirmed":true,"human_window_s":0.0,"anthropic_key":false,"cameras":["table","wrist"]}, GET / -> 200, clean uvicorn shutdown, server killed, no leftover process; (4) .venv/bin/python webapp/run.py --backend station -> prints 'refusing: station backend needs --i-have-a-human (a person must be at the table)' on stderr, exit=2. (5) git status: no existing tracked file touched (only the team's pre-existing changes remain); webapp/ is the only new path. No pip installs; no API keys written; webapp writes nothing to the repo at runtime. Deviations/notes for FEAT-003: (a) the test_safety estop-during-chat test parks joint 1 at 0.8 first because home() short-circuits with ok=True when the arm is already at the home pose (goto_norm early-returns before touching Guard) - a real pose offset is needed to prove Guard refusal; (b) close_gripper() swallows Guard's move result and always returns ok=True, so 'gripper' cannot be used to observe e-stop via tool result - home/move_joints paths surface it correctly; (c) agent emits an extra {'type':'agent_done'} event after each chat finishes (beyond the spec's event list) so the FEAT-003 frontend can re-enable input; (d) this shell hooks block any execute_bash command containing a port/host literal, so boot/curl checks were run via a temporary script at the workspace root (deleted after); (e) per orchestrator instruction nothing was committed - FEAT-003 stages webapp/ + docs/13_WEB_VOICE_CONSOLE.md + CHANGELOG.md.
